text: DSH Translate Pro（DSH 插件，通用工具客户端）：为 DSH 提供文本和整文件翻译。它通过 translate 与 translate_file 两个工具调用 SiliconFlow 上的 DeepSeek 模型，可选目标语言、来源语言、正式/口语/技术/直译风格和术语表。文件翻译保留文档结构，并可选择将译文写回文件。适合需要翻译对话文本、README、文档、字幕或代码注释的用户。使用前需要配置 SILICONFLOW_API_KEY；文件翻译还需要文件服务。

DSH Translate Pro adds text and file translation tools to DSH. Choose a target language, style, model, and glossary; file translation preserves document structure and can write back. It uses DeepSeek through SiliconFlow and needs SILICONFLOW_API_KEY. File translation requires the filesystem service.
想把一段文字翻译成指定语言，还能选择正式或口语风格。
我想让译文固定使用术语表里的译法。
能不能把 README 翻译成中文并保留 Markdown 格式？
需要翻译字幕或代码注释，同时保留命令和路径。
让 DSH 按技术文档风格翻译这段内容。
帮我把文件翻译后直接写回原路径。
I need to translate a document while keeping its Markdown and code blocks intact.
Can I translate text with a consistent glossary and a chosen tone?
功能「可控文本翻译」：translate 工具接收文本，可指定目标和来源语言、四种风格、术语表及 DeepSeek 模型，返回原文与译文格式的结果。
功能「整文件翻译」：translate_file 读取指定文件并翻译全文，要求保留 Markdown、代码块、URL、路径和标识符；默认返回原文与译文，也可启用 inPlace 写回。
功能「双模型选择」：两个工具允许选择 DeepSeek V4-Flash 或 V3.2；未指定时使用 V4-Flash。
使用前需配置 SILICONFLOW_API_KEY；翻译请求会发送到 api.siliconflow.cn 上的 DeepSeek 服务。
File translation needs the DSH filesystem service; inPlace writes the translation back to the selected file.

dsh-translate-pro README · ✨ Why this plugin：LLMs can "sort of" translate. **DSH Translate Pro** gives you *professional-grade* translation with controls you can't get from a casual chat prompt:

dsh-translate-pro README · ✨ Why this plugin：| Feature | What it does |
|---|---|
| 🌍 **18 target languages** | Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Russian, Portuguese, Italian, Arabic, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Turkish, Hindi, Polish, Dutch |
| 🎭 **4 writing styles** | `formal` / `casual` / `technical` / `literal` — from legal documents to daily chat |
| 📖 **Glossary control** | Pin terminology: `API=应用程序接口, LLM=大语言模型` — consistent terms across every translation |
| 📄 **Whole-file translation** | Translate READMEs, docs, subtitles, code comments **while preserving Markdown, code blocks, URLs, and paths** |
| ✍️ **In-place write-back** | One call translates your file and writes the result back — instant localized docs |
| 🧠 **DeepSeek engine** | Powered by DeepSeek V4-Flash (fast/cheap) or V3.2 (highest quality) via SiliconFlow |
| 🎨 **Conversation cards** | Side-by-side 原文/译文 cards rendered right in the chat stream |

dsh-translate-pro README · Prerequisite: one free API key：Register at [SiliconFlow](https://cloud.siliconflow.cn) (free credits included) and set the key:

```sh
export SILICONFLOW_API_KEY=sk-xxxxxxxx
```

Verify the layer:

```sh
dsh --profile demo --dump-config   # shows a "# == dsh-translate-pro" layer
```

Start and use it:

```sh
SILICONFLOW_API_KEY=sk-xxx dsh --profile demo
```

dsh-translate-pro README · `translate`：Translate text with full control:

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | string (required) | The text to translate |
| `target` | string | Target language (default: 中文) |
| `source` | string | Source language (auto-detected if omitted) |
| `style` | string | `formal` / `casual` / `technical` / `literal` |
| `glossary` | string | Terminology map, e.g. `API=应用程序接口,LLM=大语言模型` |
| `model` | string | `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash` (default) or `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2` |

dsh-translate-pro README · `translate_file`：Translate an entire file, preserving its format:

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | string (required) | File to translate (workspace-relative or absolute) |
| `target` | string | Target language (default: 中文) |
| `style` | string | Translation style |
| `glossary` | string | Terminology map |
| `inPlace` | boolean | Write the translation back to the file (default: false) |
| `model` | string | Engine model |
